headline: Record shipments and steel margins drive profit surge
summary_short: Steel Dynamics' Q2 FY2026 revenue rose to $6,092M (+33.4% y/y, +17.0% q/q) on record steel shipments of 3.7 million tons, with net income up 78.8% y/y to $534M ($3.69 diluted EPS) as steel-segment metal spreads widened and the aluminum unit narrowed its operating loss.
summary_long: Revenue grew 33.4% y/y and 17.0% q/q to $6,092M on record steel shipments of 3.7 million tons and improved pricing. Steel-segment operating income rose 30% q/q to $721M as the average selling price increased $105/ton to $1,298 while scrap costs rose only $16/ton to $412. Metals recycling held steady at $48M; steel fabrication eased to $85M on higher input costs despite a growing backlog. Aluminum's operating loss narrowed 48% q/q to $33M, including a $16M non-cash impairment tied to relocating a planned Arizona slab center to Mississippi. Operating cash flow was $428M; the company invested $124M in capex, paid $77M in dividends, and repurchased $200M of stock while holding $2.0B of liquidity. No explicit numeric forward guidance was given.
